method: One assistant applies five role lenses to actual browser assertions, rendered screenshots, captures and source. No human participants, quotes, satisfaction scores or measured human success rates.

roles.observation: Child-only trusted input now triggers actual browser loss warning; Stay retains exact text. Explicit shared creation preserves parent notes, and sibling pickers can reuse the new identity.
roles.hypothesis_remaining: Real interview interruptions may reveal workflow costs that scripted tasks cannot measure.

roles.observation: 1000 eligible records and60 organizations are paged, qualified and reachable. Current assignment is visible; no-search matches and no eligible records have different guidance.
roles.hypothesis_remaining: Repeat-task efficiency and comprehension of shared-record permanence require an uncoached curator.

roles.observation: Network expansion is absent where undefined; chains/cycles expose recorded closure. Two populated proposals preserve independent lifecycle/readback and baseline identity.
roles.hypothesis_remaining: A human may still mistake recorded connectivity for verified transit; disclosure is present but comprehension is unmeasured.

roles.observation: Actual200/400browser zoom, tabs, return focus, inline creation and long options pass both hosts after correcting the real short-height regression. Narrow secondary actions follow record information.
roles.hypothesis_remaining: Screen-reader announcements, physical-device input and subjective scrolling effort remain unqualified.

roles.observation: Real downloaded SVG/PNG retain scope, full caveats and source identity. Both render at presentation/print mockup sizes; deliberately zoomed detail is readable while dense overviews are topology views.
roles.hypothesis_remaining: A receiving human must explain omissions and marking before broad distribution.
